name: Object Storage (S3-compatible)
description: Upload, download, and serve files via S3-compatible object storage. Works with Replit App Storage, AWS S3, or Cloudflare R2.

requiredSecrets.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredSecrets.reason: Access key with read/write to the bucket

requiredSecrets.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: Secret key paired with the access key

requiredSecrets.name: S3_ENDPOINT
requiredSecrets.reason: Optional — only needed for non-AWS S3-compatible providers (R2, MinIO, etc.)

postInstallNotes: Browser uploads should request a presigned PUT URL from your server, then `fetch(url, { method: 'PUT', body: file })`. Never expose `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` to the browser.
